findings.finding: Bounded cleanup and watchdog exception paths can exit and release the inherited flock without verified container absence.
No watchdog ready/identity handshake or recovery signal handling exists before start.
The root-owned mode-0700 directory mounted as /work is not writable or traversable by container UID 1000.
Docker client/context, cgroups, image manifest and full actual container configuration are not strictly bound.
Unbounded PIPE capture can lose timeout streams and does not supply reviewed command/process cleanup evidence.
Writes/config replacement omit complete-write and directory-fsync durability; cleanup journals and diagnostic loss are incomplete.
The PASS predicate incompletely validates build bindings and mislabels decoded watchdog exit as raw wait status.
